entities.summary: The bit is a fundamental unit of information in computing and digital communications. It was first used by Claude Shannon in his 1948 paper on mathematical theory of communication, where he defined the bit as the basic language of information processing. The development of the bit revolutionized the field of computer science, enabling the creation of modern computers that could process and store vast amounts of data. The widespread adoption of digital technologies has made the bit an essential component of nearly every aspect of modern life, from online transactions to social media platforms. With its origins in classical computing, the bit continues to shape our understanding of information and its role in the digital age.
